verdict.rationale: Stashing is a fair question for a mobile GitHub/git app, since mobile git clients can offer local working-directory operations. However, nothing in the evidence shows GitHub Mobile has a working directory or any stash/unstash capability. Community feedback describes it as 'not really a git client', which supports absence rather than delivery.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can stash and unstash changes to temporarily clear my working directory
